value.title: LUPIN THE IIIRD: Zenigata and the Two Lupins
value.synopsis: Inspector Zenigata encounters a terrorist attack at the airport of the Lobbye, and is surprised that the murderer's face was Lupin III. He soon loses sight of it, but finds another “Lupin” at the station and restrains Lupin on the train, but he allows him to escape with the help of Daisuke Dimension. On the other hand, Mine Fujiko infiltrated the circus troupe and was favored by Supreme Leader Breyn as a rider of the aerial swing. With the disarmament treaty parade just around the corner, the National Security Council Karaskov identified and tracked Lupin as a terrorist and a spy of the United States of Alka, but Zenigata was suspicious. Standing in front of Lupin, who was cornered by the National Security Commission in the capital, was a sengata who believed in his innocence. But at that moment, a new explosion hits the sengata...
